user.title: Battery Opt
user.description: Pick the OMIE price entity and the battery parameters (defaults from CONTEXT.md). The marstek_modbus entities are optional until the battery arrives: leave all four empty for planning-only mode (plans and savings are computed, nothing actuates). Note: force_mode, set_charge_power and set_discharge_power ship disabled by default in the Marstek integration - enable them first.

error.battery_entities_all_or_none: Provide all four battery entities, or none of them (planning-only mode until the battery arrives).
